name: 33949-multiimage-qwen3vl2b-tp8
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct. Not gated; ~4.4 GB of bf16 weights to download.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, NVLink 4 / NVSwitch, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: tp8, pp1, dp1, no expert parallelism, one node. The vision encoder is data-parallel across the attention-TP ranks (--mm-enable-dp-encoder). TP=8 is part of the declaration; do not narrow it.
architecture: Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration, 2B dense, bf16 with no quantization_config. 28 decoder layers, hidden 2048, 16 query heads over 8 KV heads; vision tower 24 layers, patch_size 16, spatial_merge_size 2.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 480 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm over the OpenAI-compatible chat route, ONE turn: four distinct JPEGs at 512x512, 896x896, 1280x1280 and 1536x1536 plus 64 tokens of text in, 8 tokens out. Built as five data sources -- one synthetic_text and four synthetic_image at seeds 42-45, each with images_per_request 1 -- which is what makes one turn carrying four image parts. Images are content noise at jpeg_quality 20; output is exactly 8 tokens, pinned with ignore_eos and temperature 0.0.
purpose: A compact vision-language assistant answering single-turn questions about four mixed-resolution images at 32 concurrent streams on eight GPUs.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- a nested block is dropped by the reader, so any structured
# value has to stay on one line.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct
tp-size: 8
mm-enable-dp-encoder: true
# Also what sglang auto-resolves to for this deployment; written out so it cannot drift.
mm-feature-transport: cuda_ipc
trust-remote-code: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.7
random-seed: 42
